messages.author: 04f4344b05623f57
messages.subject: gm.prcomp not returning shapes value
parts:
Hello all,

I am attempting to find the extreme shapes for a PCA. The code runs correctly and produces a phylomorphospace. However, in the gm.prcomp output, the ‘shapes’ value is not returned. All other values are listed within the object (see attached screenshot).

The line I ran to produce the object is as follows:
paturon.pca<-gm.prcomp(paturon_coords, phy = tree, align.to.phy = FALSE)

I am using geomorph v 4.0.4, which I believe is the latest package version available on CRAN. I’m not sure if there was a change in how shape values are produced or it this is an error on my end.

 

Thank you for your time,

Cori

messages.author: aab55242ff4da6c6
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] gm.prcomp not returning shapes value
parts:
Cori,

By chance is paturon_coords a matrix of data instead of an array with three dimensions, like the output from gpagen?  There should be gm.prcomp output called, $shapes, but this is not provided if the input data are a matrix (because the function would not be able to reconcile the number and dimensions of landmarks).  If this is the case, use arrayspecs or do not transform coordinate data into a matrix with two.d.array, and it should work.

Mike
